gen.title: Recognising core tools for guiding short term rates

cards.stem: What does the text describe as the purpose of these market operations?
options: the purchase and sale of securities in the open market by a central bank
the direct lending of funds to households for mortgages
the printing of paper currency for daily circulation
the collection of taxes for government revenue
cards.quote: Open market operations (OMOs)--the purchase and sale of securities in the open market by a central bank--are a key tool
cards.hint: Focus on how the text defines the central bank action.

cards.stem: How is the overnight interbank rate defined in the passage?
options: the interest rate at which depository institutions lend reserve balances
the interest rate charged on long term government bonds
the fee for processing consumer checking accounts
the return paid on corporate equity investments
cards.quote: the federal funds rate--the interest rate at which depository institutions lend reserve balances to other depository institutions overnight
cards.hint: Look for the overnight lending description.

cards.stem: What role does the text assign to overnight reverse repurchase agreements?
options: a supplementary policy tool
a permanent replacement for open market operations
a tax for funding government spending
a loan program for small businesses
cards.quote: overnight reverse repurchase agreements (ON RRPs)--a type of OMO--as a supplementary policy tool
cards.hint: Check how the passage labels this agreement type.

cards.stem: What effect do standing repo operations have on rates according to the text?
options: provide a ceiling on rates
eliminate the need for reserve balances
set a fixed price for long term securities
replace overnight lending between banks
cards.quote: SRP operations limit upward pressure and help provide a ceiling on rates to support the monetary policy implementation
cards.hint: Note what the text says about upward pressure.
